title: scenario_expander step_column contract diverges from runtime when step_column is empty/None
description: The contract reads `sc = config.get("step_column", "scenario_index")` then only adds it to produced if truthy, whereas the builder uses `_step_col = config.get("step_column") or "scenario_index"`. These differ exactly when `step_column` is present but falsy ("" or None): the contract yields `""`/None (falsy) and omits the produced column, while the builder coalesces to "scenario_index" and always produces it. Result: the contract under-declares the produced step-index column for an explicitly-empty step_column. Under-declaring produced means the planner does not treat "scenario_index" as created here; if it happens to exist upstream the demand routing/ownership for it is wrong, and checkpoint projection metadata is inaccurate. Use the same `or` coalescing in the contract (matching the builder) so both agree.
evidence: Contract l.845: `sc = config.get("step_column", "scenario_index")` (default only applies when key absent); builder l.863: `_step_col = config.get("step_column") or "scenario_index"` (default applies for absent, "" and None). Divergence for explicit empty/None step_column.
